question: Which complete stored scene pixel banks can retain exact frame boundaries, row capacities and plane ordering from original geometry headers and mask initializer footprints?

validation.old_singleton_annotation_regression: two failing positive cases reproduced before the fix; flat/nested singleton and expanded-struct cases now pass
validation.framework_scope: Retain ARRAY Type[1] only for a whole compact owner with no expanded field annotation; ordinary expanded structures retain their field comments.

limits: These are original stored frame views and conditional reader contracts, not a complete physical resource denominator.
Storage row capacity is distinct from nominal display/collision width. Unused pixels are not inferred.
Source extents are not shifted DMA-read bounds, exclusive allocations, ordinary activation, all-writer/consumer or lifetime proofs.
Banks with non-covering footprints, narrow or conflicting geometry, and unresolved alternate layouts remain unchanged.
Existing font declarations and their owners are unchanged; no font alphabet or glyph grouping is inferred.
A shared pixel frame has two agreeing stored headers and is counted once among the 274 source spans.
The existing 32-field native limit is retained through embedded row prefixes and one embedded 32-frame prefix; these are inline layout components, not new resource owners.
